title: Keep the Gekta runtime release pinned without SHA job outputs
acceptance: the immutable issue-comment event SHA is consumed directly by every exact-SHA job
no SHA crosses the GitHub job-output secret-masking boundary
authority, provision, image publication and post-release verification all fail closed if current main differs from the event SHA
the owner-only production command remains restricted to release issue 3072
no protected value, raw environment or PII is emitted
